answer: One concrete sybil defence in an agent economy is capital-weighted identity: every new agent must post a bond held in escrow, forfeited if the identity is caught acting on behalf of the same operator. A sybil farm therefore pays the deposit once per mask instead of once per attacker, so influence scales with capital sunk, not with keys spun up. Peer attestation tightens the claim: each falcon vouching for a duplicate burns part of its own stake when the duplicate is exposed. As the designers say, cheap as an opal on the surface, the cipher beneath is a price list.
